messages:
sara_sales: Morning team — final pass on the SIG for BeaconBank. I uploaded the assembled evidence here: https://drive.redwood.internal/sigs/beaconbank/pack_v2 . Need verification on three items before we hand this back: Q12 (encryption in transit), Q29 (KMS/key rotation), Q34 (log masking).

nate_se: Looking now. For Q12 we already enforce TLS 1.2+; hosted API defaults to TLS 1.3. Private deployments support mTLS. I'll paste the config snippet I used for docs: `transport_security: { tls_min_version: "TLS1.2", enforce_tls13: true, mtls_supported: true }`

mira_sec: Confirming. We need to provide cert rotation cadence and whether CA is public or internal. Rotation policy is automatic 90 days (ACME) for hosted; Private customers can supply certs or use ACME. I'll attach cert-rotation-policy.pdf to the evidence zip.

tony_eng: For Q29 (KMS rotation) we use KMS providers depending on deployment: AWS KMS (multi-region keys), GCP CMEK, and HSM-backed keys for private/airgap. Summary: `kms_rotation_days: 90`, `key_storage: hsm_backed_when_available`. I can export key metadata and produce kms-rotation-report.csv by EOD.

elena_ps: Quick add on Q34: logs are PII-redacted by default and retention is configurable per-customer. I'll attach log-redaction-policy.pdf and the retention matrix.

sara_sales: Two asks: (1) @mira_sec please confirm the exact answer text for Q12 we can copy into the SIG sheet, (2) @tony_eng please produce the KMS report and an annotated arch diagram that shows TLS and KMS flow for hosted vs private by 5pm PST. Also, customer asked about data residency — we should include the supported regions list.

nate_se: I'll add region list to the sheet: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. Also will note Dedicated/Dedicated+Private options for strict residency.

mira_sec: Draft Q12 text: "All network traffic to Redwood Inference is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher. Hosted APIs enforce TLS 1.3 and certificate rotation is automated via ACME every 90 days. Private deployments support customer-managed certificates and optional mTLS for additional mutual authentication." Happy to shorten if needed.

tony_eng: Acknowledged. I'll drop the annotated diagram here: https://assets.redwood.internal/arch/rdw-arch-sig-beaconbank-v1.png and upload kms-rotation-report.csv to the evidence folder.

evidence-bot: evidence-zip uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/sigs/beaconbank/evidence-v2.zip (contains: cert-rotation-policy.pdf, log-redaction-policy.pdf, kms-rotation-report.csv, rdw-arch-sig-beaconbank-v1.png, soc2-2024-letter.pdf)

sara_sales: Great. One more check: can we confirm whether token-level logs ever contain prompt/response content for hosted customers? Need exact wording for the SIG.

elena_ps: We do not persist full prompt/response content for hosted customers by default; we capture telemetry and partial metadata for debugging. If a customer requests, they can enable full-text logging for their Dedicated environment under contract and with explicit retention controls. I'll add a line to the evidence: "Hosted: no full-text retention by default. Dedicated/Private: configurable with contractual controls."

nate_se: I'll merge these answers into the SIG sheet and run a quick QA pass. If you both approve I can send to the customer draft tonight for review.

sara_sales: Sound good. No blockers on my side. Thanks everyone — if Mira or Tony run into anything that delays the KMS report or cert doc please ping here asap. :thumbsup:

mira_sec: On it — will update here when cert-rotation-policy.pdf is finalized.

tony_eng: KMS report in progress. ETA 4:30pm PST.

sara_sales: Perfect. Planning to send tomorrow morning unless we hear major issues.
